goal: Deprecate encrypting existing wallets to steer users toward creating encrypted wallets upfront
Avoids fund loss from invalidated pre-encryption backups and prevents lingering plaintext key remnants
agreement: Broad support with multiple ACKs and no open objections
Support because creating a fresh encrypted wallet and sending funds is cleaner (pablomartin4btc)
Noted that test coverage for encryptwallet persistence should be retained (Eunovo)
Concept approval without stated reasons (pseudoramdom, rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because in-place encryption risks fund loss by invalidating backups made before encryption
Leaves unencrypted key remnants on disk and can silently alter descriptor spending conditions
